subject: Storly — Hosted evaluation: quickstart access, endpoints & rate caps
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Park <lena@storly.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Storly — Hosted evaluation: quickstart access, endpoints & rate caps

Hi Lena — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can spin up a hosted eval for Storly: 

Summary / ask
- You confirmed Hosted API looks like the right first path (no on-prem requirement today).
- Next: we provide a sandbox API key + two test endpoints (chat and generation) and a small token budget for a 2-week pilot.

Proposal (what we’ll do)
1) Sandbox provisioning: create a sandbox team + scoped API key with endpoint paths: /v1/generate (default model: redwood-chat-1) and /v1/embeddings (model: rwd-embed-1).
2) Rate caps for pilot: default per-second caps of 60 RPS and burst allowance to 120 RPS for 60s; per-minute token cap 150k tokens. We can adjust after you share traffic profile.
3) Prefix caching: enable prefix/KV cache for repeated prompts — we’ll apply a short-ttl cache to reduce cost for customer-facing retries.
4) Instrumentation: include request_id echo and access to the Console for latency/cost dashboards.

What I need from you
- A representative traffic sample (concurrent requests, average tokens per call, peak minute) — you mentioned a CSV with per-endpoint estimates. Reply with that or drop into the Drive link below.
- Any security must-haves (SAML, IP allowlist, or retention constraints). If you need Private/VPC, call it out and we’ll run the decision checklist.

Attachments & links
- SLA-checklist.pdf (attached): short checklist for hosted pilot expectations and data handling notes.
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-storly-eval
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/ HB-4592

Next steps / call to action
- If that looks good, I’ll provision sandbox access by EOD Thursday and share keys + sandbox guide.
- Proposed 30-min ops call: Thu 31 May 10:00–10:30 PT to confirm endpoints and rate caps.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: SLA-checklist.pdf (PDF, 28KB)]
From: Lena Park <lena@storly.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Storly — Hosted evaluation: quickstart access, endpoints & rate caps

Thanks Monica — appreciate the clear plan. A few clarifications from our side and I attached a quick traffic estimate CSV.

Answers / clarifications
- We’re leaning Hosted for the initial pilot to move fastest. No regulatory requirement for on-prem today.
- Traffic snapshot (attached): 3 primary endpoints (search-suggest, user-chat, summary). Peak concurrent requests 35, average tokens per call ~120, peak minute tokens ~85k.
- Auth & security: will need SAML SSO for our team and IP allowlist for the pilot. Data retention: default retention is fine for evaluation; full retention lockdown might be needed at SOC2 sign-off.

Questions
1) Can the per-minute token cap be increased to 250k if we need to run a spike test?
2) How isolated is the sandbox environment — will our test traffic ever be routed to other tenant pools?

I’m looping in procurement (procurement@storly.com) for billing/PO conversations once we confirm pilot scope.

-Lena
Lena Park
CTO, Storly Inc.
lena@storly.com | +1 (646) 222-9981
[Attachment: traffic_estimates.csv (CSV, 14KB)]
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Park <lena@storly.com>
Date: Wed, 31 May 2028 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Storly — Hosted evaluation: quickstart access, endpoints & rate caps

Monica / Aditya — quick internal note to align on what to provision and what to promise back to Lena. Quoting Lena’s numbers: peak concurrent 35, avg tokens 120, peak minute 85k.

Recommended approach (internal)
- Provision sandbox with the two endpoints Monica listed. Allocate initial per-minute token cap 200k and allow a one-time spike to 300k for the controlled spike test (we’ll need signoff from infra but should be doable).
- Enable tenant isolation for the sandbox: sandbox will be in our shared-hosted plane but pinned to a soft pool and tagged. Not fully dedicated, but KV/prefix cache is tenant-scoped. We should explicitly document that in the sandbox guide so the customer understands limits.
- Security: set up SAML SSO and IP allowlist in the sandbox config; retention controls noted in SLA checklist.

Action items
- Monica: provision sandbox and send keys + sandbox-access-guide.pdf to Lena and procurement.
- Aditya: prepare a short ops runbook describing limits and what happens during throttling/fallbacks (canary to cheaper model fallback).
- Rishi: confirm with infra that we can temporarily bump minute token cap to 300k and note approval window.

I’ll join the Thu ops call to help field infra questions.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Park <lena@storly.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, procurement@storly.com
Date: Wed, 31 May 2028 11:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Storly — Hosted evaluation: quickstart access, endpoints & rate caps

Lena — perfect, thanks for the traffic CSV. We’ll take the path Rishi outlined. Short answers to your questions below and next steps: 

Answers
- Token cap spike: yes — we can approve a one-time controlled spike to 300k tokens for a scheduled stress test. Please confirm desired window and we’ll coordinate with infra.
- Sandbox isolation: it’s tenant-scoped within our hosted environment (soft pool + tags). You won’t share API keys with other tenants; runtime may live on shared nodes but traffic is logically isolated. We’ll document isolation guarantees in the sandbox-access-guide.pdf.

Next steps (concrete)
1) I’ll provision sandbox and email the scoped API key + sandbox-access-guide.pdf by EOD today.
2) Proposed ops call: Thu 31 May 10:00–10:30 PT — confirm? I added procurement on this thread for billing and PO planning.
3) Please reply with preferred stress-test window for the 300k spike so Rishi can lock it with infra.

Attaching sandbox guide and SLA checklist for you to review now.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you started.

Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
[Attachments: sandbox-access-guide.pdf (PDF, 18KB); SLA-checklist.pdf (PDF, 28KB)]
